data.title: Transportation — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: transportation
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Rainy morning, can't you see?
Looking for ways to get around with me.

[Hook]
The ship… La nave
The tram… El tranvía
Let's find a way… Vamos a encontrar
On this rainy day… En este día lluvioso.
Come sail with me again.

[Verse]
Through the window, I can see,
The blimp… El dirigible, floating with glee.
The skateboard… La patineta, rides on the street,
While the rain taps a rhythm so sweet.
The cable car… El teleférico, climbs up so high,
Taking us to the sky.
Thank you… Gracias, for this moment in time,
Let's make it feel just right.

[Hook]
The ship… La nave
The tram… El tranvía
Let's find a way… Vamos a encontrar
On this rainy day… En este día lluvioso.
Come sail with me again.

[Verse]
In the rain, we find our way,
The canoe… La canoa, paddles through the grey.
The spaceship… La nave espacial, waits for the sun,
But for now, let's just have some fun.
The taxi… El taxi, honks its horn,
As the rain keeps falling, a new day is born.
